# The Last Light Survival Guide

> A free, fully-offline survival and emergency-preparedness library: 39 guide sections (medical and first aid, water, food, shelter, power, fuel, navigation, communications, security, rebuilding), 33 bundled public-domain reference books, printable emergency cards, calculators, offline maps, and a local AI assistant that cites its sources. Runs from a USB stick or a Raspberry Pi with no internet. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

Content is cross-checked against the bundled reference books and cited inline. The medical material has not yet been reviewed by a licensed clinician; in a real emergency with services available, call them first.

## Start here

- [The Last Light Survival Guide — Offline Survival Manual, Maps & AI](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/): Open the full offline survival guide: 39 sections on medical care, water, food, shelter, power, fuel, navigation and rebuilding, emergency cards, calculators, maps and an AI that cites its sources.
- [The Last Light Survival Guide — Free Offline Survival Library](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/home.html): The Last Light Survival Guide — a complete, fully-offline survival library. 39 sections, 33 reference books, an AI that cites its sources, and offline maps. Free. Runs off a USB stick, even a Raspberry Pi.
- [Emergency Quick Reference](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/quick-reference.html): Emergency Quick Reference Card — critical survival information on one printable page.
- [Download & Support](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/download.html): Download The Last Light Survival Guide — a free offline copy you can keep on a USB drive forever. Pick a package, add the offline AI, and support the project if it's useful.
- [About](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/about.html): About The Last Light Survival Guide — a complete, fully-offline survival library built to keep working when the grid doesn't. Offline-first, zero dependencies, private, and free.

## Guide sections

- [Agriculture](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/agriculture.html): Agriculture & Food Production — soil science, seed saving, irrigation, livestock, beekeeping, aquaponics, and community-scale farming with SVG diagrams.
- [Animal Husbandry](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/animal.html): Animal Husbandry — raising chickens, goats, and rabbits for eggs, milk, and meat; basic veterinary care; slaughter and butchering.
- [Power Generation](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/build-power.html): Build your own power generation from scratch: pedal generators, water wheels, wind turbines, biogas digesters, thermoelectric generators, and steam engines.
- [Building & Structures](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/build-structures.html): Post-collapse building guide: emergency debris huts, cob construction, earthbag domes, timber frame joinery, and layered defensive perimeter design.
- [Water Systems](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/build-water.html): Complete water systems for long-term survival: rainwater harvesting, tank construction, well digging, gravity distribution, purification, and irrigation.
- [Chemistry & Materials](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/chemistry.html): Making essentials from raw materials: soap, alcohol, charcoal and activated charcoal, candles and oil lamps, tanned hides, lime mortar, glues — and which chemicals must never be mixed.
- [Climate & Regional Survival](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/climate.html): Climate & Regional Survival — zone-specific survival strategies, UK wild edibles, foraging calendar, and country-specific hazards.
- [Communications & Signals](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/communications.html): Communications & Signals — ham radio, Baofeng setup, Morse code, signal fires, Meshtastic/LoRa mesh networks, NOAA weather radio, and dead drops.
- [Disaster Playbooks](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/disasters.html): Disaster playbooks — specific survival protocols for earthquakes, hurricanes, wildfires, floods, pandemics, grid-down EMP, nuclear events, civil unrest, and chemical spills.
- [Energy Creation & Management](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/energy.html): Energy Creation & Management — solar power, generators, micro-hydro, wind, wood gasification, batteries, Faraday cages, and fuel storage.
- [Food, Water & Sanitation](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/food.html): Food, Water & Sanitation — purification, preservation, foraging, hunting, and sanitation without running water.
- [Making Fuel](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/fuel.html): Making fuel when the pumps are dry: which fuels suit which engines, biodiesel from used cooking oil (with a batch calculator), straight veg oil, fuel ethanol, wood gas, biogas, dry wood and charcoal, and keeping fuel usable.
- [Community Governance](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/governance.html): Forming and running a community through a long crisis: group roles, vetting strangers, governance models, justice, property, trade, record keeping and printable charter templates.
- [Knots & Rope](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/knots.html): Six knots that do nine-tenths of the work — bowline, clove hitch, taut-line hitch, sheet bend, trucker's hitch and reef knot — each tied step by step, with what it is for and how it fails.
- [Knowledge & Preservation](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/knowledge.html): Knowledge & Preservation — preserving books, essential reading list, community libraries, teaching systems, record keeping, digital archiving, and teaching children.
- [Pregnancy & Infant Care](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/maternal.html): Pregnancy, birth, and infant care without a hospital — prenatal checks, normal labour and delivery, danger signs, postpartum and newborn care, breastfeeding, and infant illness warning signs.
- [Medical & First Aid](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/medical.html): Medical & First Aid — wound care, fractures, burns, emergency childbirth, herbal medicine, triage, and mental health in survival situations.
- [Medicine Making](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/medicine-making.html): Emergency herbal medicine: tinctures, salves, improvised antiseptics, ORS formula, pain management, fever treatment, and medicinal plant identification for when pharmaceuticals are unavailable.
- [Metallurgy](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/metallurgy.html): Metallurgy & Blacksmithing — forge building, heat treating, tool making from scrap, casting aluminum and bronze, and working iron and steel without modern infrastructure.
- [Navigation & Maps](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/navigation.html): Navigation & Maps — topographic maps, compass use, celestial navigation, natural navigation, map-making, and urban navigation.
- [NBC Threats](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/nbc.html): Nuclear, biological and chemical threats: fallout shelter, an improvised fallout meter, potassium iodide dosing, radiation sickness, EMP and Faraday cages, disease outbreaks and decontamination.
- [First 24 Hours](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/prep-24h.html): Step-by-step players for the first day of the most common UK emergencies: a power cut, a flood warning, a gas leak or CO alarm, a water outage or boil notice, an evacuation order, and being stuck in snow. Each also opens full screen in Emergency mode.
- [Bunkers & Shelter Rooms](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/prep-bunkers.html): Realistic shelters for UK homes, from an inner refuge room to an upgraded cellar, a buried prefabricated pod and an engineered bunker: what each protects against, why buried shipping containers collapse, ventilation and CO₂ with a shelter air calculator, earth cover and protection factors, damp, radon, escape hatches, planning permission and building regulations, and living inside.
- [What to Buy](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/prep-buy.html): A buying guide for emergencies: things you use every day that also save you when the power, water or shops fail, the vital items to buy once and keep, what to look for (safety standards, capacities, ratings), what to avoid, and a shopping list builder for your budget.
- [The Prepped Home](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/prep-home.html): Preparing a typical house for emergencies: finding the stopcock, gas valve and fuse box, storing and finding water, food in a power cut, light, power, keeping warm when the boiler stops, safe cooking, a bucket toilet, medicines, documents, the Priority Services Register, pets, children and a grab bag.
- [Rural & Homestead](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/prep-rural.html): Prepping in the countryside and on a smallholding: being cut off by snow and floods, private water supplies and pumps, UK petrol storage law (30 and 275 litre limits), heating oil, LPG and firewood, backup power, growing and keeping food, registering livestock, medical help far away, and community emergency plans.
- [Stockpile & Rotation](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/prep-stockpile.html): Building and keeping a food and supplies store: a stockpile planner for water, food, gas and toilet bags by household and days, what to store for a balanced diet, a shelf-life table, best-before versus use-by, storage conditions, sealing dry food in Mylar with oxygen absorbers, oldest-first rotation with a tracker, and non-food stores.
- [Urban & Flats](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/prep-urban.html): Prepping in a flat or city: storing water and food in small spaces, a floor-load checker for water storage, high-rise risks (lifts, water pumps, fire strategy), when to stay and when to go, the get-home bag, a walk-home calculator and route planning, keeping a low profile and organising your building.
- [Campervan & Mobile](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/prep-van.html): A campervan or motorhome as an emergency home and bug-out vehicle: a cutaway of the van's systems, a power and water autonomy calculator, gas and carbon monoxide safety, water and waste, where you can stop in the UK, a packing list, winter use, when to abandon the van, and a winter car kit.
- [Prepping: Start Here](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/prepping.html): Preparing before anything goes wrong: the UK government's 72-hour advice and the tiers beyond it, a readiness ladder you can tick off, what fails first in a power cut, prepping myths, building stores on a budget, a printable household plan and practice weekends.
- [Practical Projects](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/projects.html): Practical build projects for self-reliance: evaporative cooling/aircon, air filtration, dams & hydro power, pumping water without power, toilets & sanitation, checking for radiation, building a grain mill, breeding herd animals & chickens, and long-term food storage.
- [Psychology & Morale](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/psychology.html): Mental health in a prolonged crisis: the stress response, tactical breathing, grief, PTSD and peer support, suicide risk, decisions under stress, group morale, children and withdrawal.
- [Salvage & Rebuild](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/salvage.html): Salvage, rebuild and fuel-making — where to find parts when there are no shops, how to strip machines safely, maintain and rebuild generators, salvage and rebuild batteries, and where to find the fuel-making guide.
- [First Principles](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/science.html): First principles for rebuilding: the periodic table, core physics and chemistry, the equations that actually matter in the field, and a method for inventing your own tools and systems from scratch.
- [Security & Defense](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/security.html): Security & Defense — community organization, perimeter security, de-escalation, firearms, non-lethal defense, OPSEC, fortification, and bug-out decisions.
- [Shelter & Construction](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/shelter.html): Shelter & Construction — site selection, emergency shelters, timber framing, earthbag, cob building, passive solar, insulation, and tools.
- [Textiles & Clothing](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/textiles.html): Clothing without factories: fibre sources, spinning, weaving, knitting, sewing, leatherwork, boot making, repairs and layering for warmth — from raw material to finished garment.
- [Vehicles & Transport](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/vehicles.html): Vehicles & Transport — transport hierarchy, bicycle maintenance, engine basics, alternative fuels (wood gas, biodiesel, ethanol), animal transport, and watercraft construction.
- [Veterinary Care](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/sections/veterinary.html): Keeping livestock healthy without a vet — vital signs, recognising sickness, common diseases by species, parasites, wounds and hoof care, birthing complications, biosecurity, and humane culling.

## Reference and tools

- [Calculators & Tools](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/tools.html): Offline survival calculators: food and water needs for a group, off-grid power sizing, supply tracker, planting calendar, stay-or-go decision, radio frequencies, antibiotic dosing and firewood estimates.
- [Emergency Cards](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/cards.html): Printable wallet-size emergency cards — CPR, bleeding control, water purification, signals and key numbers. Print on cardstock, cut out, laminate and keep in a wallet or go-bag.
- [Master Gear List](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/gear.html): Master Gear List — every item in The Last Light Survival Guide organized by category, priority tier, and preparedness progress.
- [Practical Skills](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/skills.html): Practical Skills — interactive step-by-step visual guides for every critical survival skill. Fire, knots, navigation, first aid, hunting, plants, construction.
- [Reference Library](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/literature.html): The reference library: 33 public-domain survival, medical and engineering books bundled as searchable PDFs, plus 60 curated titles worth owning, with acquisition tracking.
- [Offline Maps](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/maps.html): Offline interactive map — renders OpenStreetMap vector data (PMTiles) right in your browser with no internet and no map server. Prototype region: Northern England & Yorkshire.
- [Expansion Library](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/expansion.html): Expand the guide with the entire offline knowledge of humanity — all of Wikipedia, all of Project Gutenberg, medical encyclopedias, repair guides and more, via Kiwix ZIM files. Download once, read forever offline.
- [Print the Essentials](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/print-essentials.html): Every emergency step card on a few printable sheets — bleeding, CPR, choking, burns and more. Print, cut out and keep in your first-aid kit.
- [Master Index (Printable)](https://bunkerbot.co.uk/index-print.html): Printable master index of The Last Light Survival Guide — every section, tool, and bundled reference book, so the whole archive is navigable on paper.
